subject: general
question: EGDH is related to KMJN in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, QSPT is related to WYVZ. To which of the following is CEBF related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (6) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• 'EGDH’ is written as 'KMJN'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30fe5732fda4d20e1dfb834913e49bd6b8379efde1ba5dcfdac42fa4826776dd.png] 

And,

 
• 'QSPT' is written as 'WYVZ'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/778a57bb8a9d483c1fc5e24a00188aa5036f9c92b76d212139d2a13a2c9c51c1.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'CEBF' is written as 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20b1938c47e31556f595962d6af95d55b551de0af0d95765718f2d07c78beb4d.png] 

Hence, "**IKHL**" is the correct answer.
